consequence.statement: Existing CleanupPolicy objects stay stored as v2beta1 until rewritten, so the operator must run a storage version migration and update status.storedVersions on cleanuppolicies.kyverno.io before a later release removes v2beta1.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, rewrite every CleanupPolicy object so it is stored as v2. Then remove v2beta1 from status.storedVersions on the cleanuppolicies.kyverno.io CRD.

assertion.statement: From 1.12.6 to 1.13.0, the storage version of the cleanuppolicies.kyverno.io CRD changes from v2beta1 to v2, so existing CleanupPolicy objects need a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update before v2beta1 is removed.
